newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangshen Railway to announce reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Guangshen Railway to announce reshuffle.

text.p: China's Guangshen Railway Co Ltd will announce a personnel reshuffle on Tuesday, company officials said.
Trading in the firm's shares listed in Hong Kong and New York was suspended after closing on June 6 pending a company announcement.

"We are likely to make an announcement on a personnel shake-up today and trading in our shares is expected to resume after the announcement," a company official in Shenzhen told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Officials declined to give further details.
